Tereina is on a mission to revolutionize B2B payments. We are a well-funded, early-stage startup building cutting-edge solutions that transform how businesses move money. Our platform handles cross-border payment processing, counterparty management, bank account administration, and compliance workflows for eterprise customers worldwide.
We are building a modern portal application using a service-oriented architecture with Spring Boot microservices, a Spring Boot BFF (Backend for Frontend), and a custom frontend built with SAP UI5 Web Components, React and TypeScript. We are currently evolving our UX with a clean, data-rich design language focused on advanced search, tabular data views, and dashboard analytics.
About the Role
As a Senior Fullstack Engineer, you will be a key technical leader responsible for shaping the user experience of the Tereina Portal. You will own the frontend architecture, drive the implementation of our new design system, and work across the full stack to ensure our UX vision is realized with production-quality code. You will partner closely with product, design, and backend engineers to deliver enterprise-grade interfaces for payment operations, counterparty management, and compliance with workflows.
This role demands deep expertise in modern frontend technologies, a strong eye for design quality, and the ability to influence architecture decisions across the portal and its supporting BFF layer. You will mentor other engineers on UX best practices and help define our standards for accessibility, performance, and component reusability.
Key Responsibilities
Framework Development
These are the responsibilities focused on building the underlying systems, architecture, and shared infrastructure:

- Frontend Architecture: Own and evolve the frontend architecture of the Tereina Portal, including the component library, state management patterns, and data-fetching layer built on our existing frontend infrastructure.

- Design System Implementation: Lead the implementation of our evolving design system, translating UX designs into reusable, accessible components using SAP UI5 Web Components and TypeScript. Establish patterns for dashboards, data tables, search interfaces, and detail views.

- BFF Collaboration: Work closely with the BFF layer (Spring Boot) to shape API contracts, optimize data-fetching patterns, and ensure the portal proxy controllers deliver exactly what the frontend needs. Influence the design of search proxy endpoints and OpenAPI specifications.

- Performance & Accessibility: Champion frontend performance optimization (lazy loading, caching strategies, efficient re-renders) and WCAG accessibility standards across all portal views.

Rollout & Adoption

- Search & Data Views: Architect the frontend implementation of our new standardized search framework, integrating table-based server-side pagination, sorting, and filtering via our REST filter contracts. Implement column configuration, saved searches, and spreadsheet exports.

- Implement data visualizations that surface actionable insights for enterprise payment operations.

- Cross-Functional Leadership: Partner with Product, Design, and Platform teams to translate business requirements into UX solutions. Drive UX technical decisions and advocate for user experience quality in architectural discussions.

- Expert proficiency in TypeScript and modern JavaScript.

- Expert-level React experience, including deep knowledge of hooks, state management patterns, and component architecture, with a track record of building complex, data-rich web applications

- Hands-on experience with headless table libraries (TanStack Table preferred) including server-side pagination, sorting, and filtering

- Proven ability to build responsive, accessible (WCAG 2.1 AA) interfaces for enterprise applications

- Experience with BFF (Backend for Frontend) patterns and REST API integration, including OpenAPI-generated clients

- Solid understanding of authentication flows (OAuth2/OIDC, session-based auth) and security best practices (CSRF, CSP)

- Experience with AI agent frontends — streaming UI, conversation management, and integration with Spring AI, LangChain, or MCP backends

- Experience with data visualization libraries and building dashboard interfaces with charts and analytics components

- Strong system design skills with the ability to influence architecture decisions across frontend and API layers

- Excellent communication skills and experience collaborating in cross-functional agile teams

- Professional fluency in English (written and verbal) is required; all engineering collaboration, documentation, code reviews, and stakeholder communication are conducted in English

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with SAP UI5, SAP UI5 Web Components, or enterprise UI frameworks in regulated industries

- Familiarity with Spring Boot BFF architectures and Java/Kotlin backend services

- Background in fintech, payment processing, or B2B financial platforms

- Experience with SheetJS or similar client-side data export libraries

- Knowledge of JPA Specifications or similar backend query patterns and how they map to frontend filter UIs

- Experience building multi-tenant SaaS applications with organization-scoped data access

- Track record of leading frontend architect

jobs.title: Software Engineer - Postgres Tooling
jobs.description:
ABOUT SUPABASE

Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for a Software Engineer, Postgres Tooling to join our CLI team and help build the open-source tools developers use to change their Postgres schemas safely. You’ll join as a co-maintainer of pg-delta, our schema diff and migration engine, and grow into leading it.

Given two databases, or a database and a folder of SQL files describing the schema you want, pg-delta works out the differences and generates the migration to get from one to the other. It powers supabase db diff, db pull, and declarative schemas, and it runs underneath Supabase’s platform, branching, and AI agent workflows. Every migration it generates is verified on a throwaway clone before it’s trusted, and it’s tested against 331 scenarios on PostgreSQL 14–18. We’re now working toward a stable, standalone 1.0 release for any Postgres developer, on Supabase or not.

This is a correctness-first role. The SQL this tool generates runs against production databases, so privilege safety and avoiding data loss are non-negotiable. It’s a great fit for someone who loves Postgres at the catalog level, enjoys compiler-style problems, and thrives in async, fast-paced environments.

WHAT YOU’LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR

In this role, you’ll:

- Co-maintain pg-delta: review and merge changes, including PRs written by AI agents, and grow into its lead maintainer.

- Own correctness: triage bug reports from GitHub and support, fix diff and dependency-ordering bugs, and extend test coverage across Postgres versions.

- Make sure generated migrations are privilege-safe and never silently lose data, by detecting destructive changes and rewriting them into safe equivalents where possible.

- Help take pg-delta to a stable 1.0: a public API with a semver contract, documentation, and broader coverage of Postgres extensions.

- Work with the open-source community: triage issues, review outside contributions, and say no gracefully when a request doesn’t fit.

- Work with the teams across Supabase that build on pg-delta, so migrations are generated and run the same way everywhere.

- Write the design docs and technical strategy that set the tool’s direction, working async across teams.

- Share the CLI team’s on-call rotation. Weekdays are covered follow-the-sun, and because we ship packaged software that users can roll back, pages are rare.

YOU MIGHT BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU

Must have:

- Have 8+ years of experience as a software engineer, including deep, hands-on work with PostgreSQL.

- Know Postgres internals at the catalog level: pg_catalog, pg_depend, object ownership, grants and default privileges, RLS policies, and extension membership.

- Understand DDL and migration semantics: which changes take locks, which can’t run inside a transaction, how dependencies determine ordering, and how to spot a destructive change.

- Treat a migration that silently loosens access as a top-severity bug.

- Write strong TypeScript, and design tests for correctness, such as differential, property-based, or corpus testing across multiple Postgres versions.

- Are comfortable with compiler-style problems: dependency graphs, topological ordering, cycle handling, and diffing.

- Can confidently review complex changes in an intricate codebase, including AI-generated PRs.

- Have owned software in production with users in the loop: staged rollouts, error monitoring, and triaging real bug reports.

- Have led a technical project across several teams, from an ambiguous start to production.

- Communicate clearly in writing and thrive in async, globally distributed teams.

Nice to have, roughly in order of how much they’d help:

- Have built or maintained schema diff or migration tooling (such as migra, pg-schema-diff, Atlas, pgroll, sqitch, Prisma Migrate, or Flyway/Liquibase), or worked with pg_dump internals.

- Open-source maintainer experience: API contracts, semver, documentation, and community triage.

- Familiarity with Postgres extensions such as pg_cron, pgmq, pg_partman, vault, pg_net, pgvector, or PostGIS.

- Experience with Go.

- Contributions to Postgres itself, or authorship of a Postgres extension.

- Experience with Supabase or another managed Postgres platform.

WHAT WE OFFER

- Fully Remote

We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world.

- ESOP

Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together.

- Tech Allowance

Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work.

- Health Benefits

Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us.

- Annual Off-Sites

Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year.

- Flexible Work

We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when.

- Professional Development

Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth.

ABOUT THE TEAM

Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love.

- ~400 team members

- 60+ countries

- 20+ languages spoken

- Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F)

- 540,000+ community members

We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in you

You own customer and business outcomes, not tickets. What sets this role apart is judgment: knowing the smallest thing worth shipping, when to drop your own idea, and when AI output is good enough versus when to override it. On LeadConduit, that work splits evenly between two areas: keeping today's platform fast and reliable for the customers who run their business on it, and building the next-generation platform, including a new real-time engine for ping/post, call tracking, and buyer optimization.
You'll move between the LeadConduit team and the initiatives you deploy into, shipping early, talking to customers, and deciding fast.
Responsibilities

- Own outcomes end-to-end, wherever you're assigned. Frame the problem, design it, ship it, own the metric. Distill to the cheapest version that works. Prototype in days.

- Work across today's LeadConduit and the next-generation platform. Improve the current product (flows, integrations, reporting) and help build the new real-time engine (field mapping, ping/post, call tracking, buyer optimization).

- Stay close to customers. Shadow sales and support, talk with lead buyers and sellers, join advisory conversations, and let customer reality drive technical decisions. Propose what to build, defer, and drop.

- Own your domain and share it. Its interfaces, reliability, performance, and security, including on-call for the systems you own. Consent, TCPA compliance, and PII handling are central to customer trust. Bring patterns, tooling, and hard-won context back to the wider org rather than hoarding them.

- Build and scale both the product surface and the platform beneath it. Ship responsive, accessible interfaces with a strong UI/UX eye (Vue/Nuxt today, React/Next.js for the new platform), back them with Node.js and TypeScript services and APIs, and keep the real-time, multi-tenant lead and call processing engine reliable and fast as volume grows.

- Architect AI-driven leverage. Build AI-assisted workflows that hold up, evolve the team's practices as tooling changes (Cursor, Claude Code, and whatever comes next), and look for product wins AI unlocks (smarter routing, anomaly detection on lead flow, AI-built integrations, and more).

- Make every team you work with stronger. Mentor on judgment and product sense, not just syntax. Write decision memos and ADRs. Enable Product and Design to self-serve.

Qualifications and Skills

- A track record of shipping something end-to-end that you cared about and owning the outcome, not just the code.

- Product judgment: pushing back on a bad spec, proposing the cheapest experiment, descoping, and collaborating with Product to suggest solutions rather than waiting for a fully specified ticket.

- Comfort embedding with unfamiliar teams and codebases, getting productive fast, and leaving them better than you found them.

About MISUMI Americas

MISUMI Americas, a division of MISUMI Group, is a leading provider of standard, configurable, and custom manufacturing solutions. By integrating a vast catalog of components with a world-class digital manufacturing platform, MISUMI Americas empowers engineers and procurement teams to accelerate innovation across the entire product lifecycle. With operations in the San Francisco Bay Area and Chicago, the company serves as a vital partner for the most innovative companies in the Americas.

About Compass
Compass is a new venture incubated within MISUMI Americas. We’re building it with the deep manufacturing expertise of Fictiv , MISUMI’s digital manufacturing platform.
Every physical product starts as a CAD model, and most of what it will cost is decided right there. Yet cost and manufacturability are still checked after the drawings are released, by hand and in spreadsheets, when every change is slow and expensive. The result is redesigns, missed schedules, and money left on the factory floor. Compass fixes that at the source. An engineer uploads an assembly, and Compass reads every part the way an expert manufacturing engineer would. It checks each feature against the processes that could make it, prices the part at the volume that matters, reads tolerances and GD&T straight off the drawing, and ranks exactly what to change. It does this across the entire bill of materials, reruns on every revision, and learns from every correction engineers make.
The problems underneath are genuinely hard: making sense of real-world geometry, modeling cost across machining, casting, molding, sheet metal, and additive, interpreting engineering drawings, and building AI that gets measurably better from expert feedback. The stakes are real, too. Our customers are enterprise engineering teams, including aerospace and defense programs, where the platform has to be as secure and trustworthy as it is smart. jobs.title: Full-Stack Engineer (Mid-Level)
jobs.description:
Description
We are hiring a Full-Stack Engineer to design, build, and run production applications on Microsoft Azure, from APIs and data to the web interfaces clients use every day.
Much of the work starts with prototypes and AI-assisted builds that prove an idea but aren't ready for real clients. You'll turn them into secure, tested, observable systems that scale, working closely with AI/ML engineers, product and project managers, CX designers, and operations teams.
What You'll Do

-
Build backend services: Develop APIs and services with clear boundaries, automated tests, and code review.

-
Build frontend applications: Create client portals, internal consoles, admin screens, and dashboards.

-
Take prototypes to production: Review AI-generated and prototype codebases, determine what to keep or rebuild, and prepare them for real users.

-
Integrate AI services: Connect AI models and services, including real-time features.

-
Run applications on Azure: Manage infrastructure as code and CI/CD across development, staging, and production environments.

-
Connect third-party systems: Build integrations with CRMs, ticketing tools, and other platforms.

-
Maintain reliability and observability: Implement logging, metrics, tracing, alerts, and participate in an on-call rotation.

-
Protect data: Implement authentication, multi-tenant isolation, secure secrets management, and safe handling of personal data.

-
Document solutions: Maintain clear technical documentation that helps other engineers work effectively.

Our Technology Stack

-
Frontend: TypeScript, React, Next.js, Azure Static Web Apps, or Azure App Service.

-
Backend: Node.js, Python, Azure App Service, Container Apps, and Functions.

-
Data: PostgreSQL or Azure SQL, Cosmos DB, Redis, and Blob Storage.

-
Messaging: Azure Service Bus, Event Grid, and Event Hubs.

-
Identity and access: Microsoft Entra ID, Entra External ID, managed identities, and role-based access control (RBAC).

-
Security: Azure Key Vault, virtual networks, private endpoints, and Microsoft Defender for Cloud.

-
Delivery: Docker, Azure Container Registry, Bicep or Terraform, GitHub Actions, or Azure DevOps.

-
Observability: Azure Monitor, Application Insights, Log Analytics, and OpenTelemetry.

Working Environment
You'll work remotely from Colombia or Mexico, collaborating with AI/ML engineers, project management, CX design, and BPO operations teams. Working hours are aligned with EST business hours.
We value engineers who take ownership, make sound technical decisions, build secure and reliable systems, and communicate clearly across teams.
﻿

﻿Hiring Process
To ensure fairness and consistency, all applicants must complete every stage of the hiring process.
Our process includes:

- Resume Review

- Pre-Screen Questionnaire

- One-Way Video Interview

- Live Interview

Please Note

- ﻿ This is an English-speaking role that requires strong written and verbal English communication skills.

- All resumes must be submitted in English to be considered for this position.

Requirements
What You'll Bring

- 3–5 years of experience building and running production web applications across both backend and frontend.

- At least 2 years of experience building and running applications on Microsoft Azure.

- Strong TypeScript, Node.js, and React skills, with working knowledge of Python for AI/ML services.

- Experience designing and integrating REST or GraphQL APIs.

- Experience with relational and NoSQL databases, caching, and queues.

- Familiarity with real-time or event-driven systems, including WebSockets, streaming, and messaging queues.

- Experience integrating third-party APIs, including LLM providers.

- Experience with CI/CD using GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps.

- Familiarity with Docker and infrastructure-as-code tools such as Bicep or Terraform.

- Good testing, monitoring, debugging, and code review practices.

- A track record of turning prototypes or AI-generated code into stable production applications by addressing security gaps, weak error handling, and missing tests.

- Familiarity with AI coding tools such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or Claude Code, and the ability to review, validate, and correct their output.

- Professional written and spoken English and Spanish.

- Based in Colombia or Mexico, with the right to work in that country.

Nice to Have

- Azure certifications, such as Azure Developer Associate or Azure Solutions Architect Expert.

- Experience with C# and .NET.

- Experience with Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search, or Azure AI Speech.

- Familiarity with Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS).

- Experience implementing LLM patterns, including function calling, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), AI agents, and evaluations.

- Experience with Dynamics 365, Salesforce, Zendesk, or similar platforms.

- Experience in customer service, contact center, or BPO technology.

- Familiarity with SOC 2, PCI DSS, or HIPAA environments.

- Knowledge of Mexico's LFPDPPP or Colombia's Ley 1581.
